description: Pembrolizumab is recommended as an option for treating locally advanced or metastatic PD-L1-positive non-small-cell lung cancer in adults who have had at least one chemotherapy (and targeted treatment if they have an epidermal growth factor receptor [EGFR]- or anaplastic lymphoma kinase [ALK]-positive tumour), only if pembrolizumab is stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment and no documented disease progression, and the company provides pembrolizumab in line with the commercial access agreement with NHS England.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab for the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic PD-L1-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults who have had at least one prior chemotherapy regimen, and targeted treatment if they have an EGFR- or ALK-positive tumour, with pembrolizumab stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment if there is no documented disease progression. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS
